newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia industry output up 29.27 pct in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia industry output up 29.27 pct in Jan-May.

text.p: Mongolia's gross industrial output at current prices increased 29.27 percent to 111.4153 billion tugriks in January-May 1997 from 86.1814 billion in the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bulletin said on Wednesday.
The major increases were in the energy, mining and food industries, it said.

Output of coal mining in the first five months was 11.6031 billion tugriks, up from 6.2329 billion in the year-ago period, while electricity and thermal energy generation increased to 31.0091 billion tugriks, up from 17.2620 billion.

Mining of metal ores rose to 27.0274 billion tugriks, from 20.0569 billion in the year-ago period, while production of food and beverages increased to 20.2171 billion tugriks, up from 15.7749 billion a year ago.
Sales in January-May increased to 148.1926 billion tugriks, up from 108.0136 billion in the same period previous year.
